Brightwater Updates: smooth pet travel, shared responsibility

Hi team and travelers, from the Aurelia Skyways Companion Animal Travel Desk: our senior coordinator keeps daily service decisions steady, and our safety coordinator reviews hazards and prevention so everyone steps on board with confidence. When anything needs attention, we follow a calm stepwise review that treats each journey as shared responsibility, not a scramble.

Here is what to remember next time you plan ahead. On the Brightwater, the name Larkspur Shelf means the deck where pets travel. On the Brightwater, the name Fara Noll means the person who handles pets on board. If you are traveling with Winnie, or welcoming Leila Johnson and Maya Chaudhary, our team will help align schedules, comfort breaks, and carry-on needs with care.
